# Architecture Decision Records

Every decision that shapes the stack is recorded here as an ADR
([04-engineering-standards.md](../plan/04-engineering-standards.md#documentation)). States run
Proposed → Accepted → Superseded or Deprecated; an accepted ADR changes only by a new ADR
superseding it.

| ADR | Title | Status | Date |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [0001](0001-gazebo-harmonic-as-physics-and-sensor-engine.md) | Gazebo Harmonic as the physics and sensor engine | Accepted | 2026-10-14 |
| [0002](0002-ros2-jazzy-primary-ros1-via-bridge.md) | ROS 2 Jazzy is the primary interface; ROS 1 is supported through a bridge | Accepted | 2026-10-14 |
| [0003](0003-web-cockpit-threejs-foxglove-protocol.md) | A browser-based cockpit built with Three.js, speaking the Foxglove WebSocket protocol | Accepted | 2026-10-14 |
| [0004](0004-one-container-per-vehicle.md) | One container per vehicle, built from the vehicle's own repository | Accepted | 2026-10-14 |
| [0005](0005-declarative-yaml-scenarios.md) | Scenarios are declarative YAML validated by a versioned schema | Accepted | 2026-10-14 |
| [0006](0006-sim-time-default-realtime-locked-mode.md) | Simulated time by default, with a real-time-locked mode | Accepted | 2026-10-14 |
| [0007](0007-fidelity-tiers.md) | Three explicit fidelity tiers: SIL, emulated target, HIL | Accepted | 2026-10-14 |
| [0008](0008-monorepo-apache2-github.md) | Single public monorepo on GitHub under the Apache-2.0 licence | Accepted | 2026-10-14 |
| [0009](0009-languages-per-layer.md) | Python for orchestration, C++ for Gazebo plugins, TypeScript for the cockpit | Accepted | 2026-10-14 |

New decisions start from [0000-adr-template.md](0000-adr-template.md) on a branch
`adr/<nnnn>-<slug>`, reviewed in their own pull request
([05-working-model.md](../plan/05-working-model.md#changing-the-plan)).
